title: Dodge Windows Panel is not dodging System Monitor's sub-window
line: A Dodge Windows panel now hides when a dialog, like System Monitor's Configure Columns, covers it.
explanation: The panel decides whether a window touches it with a TasksModel that filters out windows that skip the taskbar. On Wayland libtaskmanager reports every transient window (a dialog with a parent) as skipping the taskbar so it doesn't get its own task button, so dialogs never counted and a Dodge Windows panel stayed on top of them. libtaskmanager gains an IsTransient role and a filterTransients property on TasksModel, and the panel sets filterTransients: false so dialogs count like any other window; Plasma's own popups and notifications have no parent window and are still ignored.

commits.message:
libtaskmanager: add a filterTransients property to TasksModel

Transient windows such as dialogs are reported as skipping the taskbar,
so a model that filters those can never see them. Add an IsTransient
role and a filterTransients property to let users of the model keep them.

BUG: 517721

panel: count dialogs as touching windows

Dialogs were left out of the windows that touch the panel, so a Dodge
Windows panel stayed on top of them and a floating panel didn't stop
floating. Keep transient windows in the model so they count like others.

BUG: 517721

From 0247bbd87d25779e5e3060f3faa8d44f01d09965 Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: =?UTF-8?q?Niccol=C3=B2=20Venerandi?= <niccolo@venerandi.com>
Date: Sat, 21 Nov 2026 08:45:38 +0100
Subject: [PATCH] panel: count dialogs as touching windows

Dialogs were left out of the windows that touch the panel, so a Dodge
Windows panel stayed on top of them and a floating panel didn't stop
floating. Keep transient windows in the model so they count like others.

BUG: 517721
---
 desktoppackage/contents/views/Panel.qml | 1 +
 1 file changed, 1 insertion(+)

diff --git a/desktoppackage/contents/views/Panel.qml b/desktoppackage/contents/views/Panel.qml
index aea1844c5b..a79758d6ab 100644
--- a/desktoppackage/contents/views/Panel.qml
+++ b/desktoppackage/contents/views/Panel.qml
@@ -110,6 +110,7 @@ Item {
         filterByRegion: TaskManager.RegionFilterMode.Intersect
         filterHidden: true
         filterMinimized: true
+        filterTransients: false
 
         screenGeometry: panel.screenGeometry
         activity: activityInfo.currentActivity
--
